report:
Reviewed the full meta.reviews.record_required claim, its sole ordinary implementation association in review.rs, and all six ordinary associated tests; no TODO/N/A entries exist. Requirements are: missing/re-evaluation work stays failing until completed recording; preparation, reads and drafts are insufficient; interrupted/failed starts cannot reuse approval; completion additionally needs a complete no-edits report and fresh inputs; each anchor is independent. review.rs implements these through start removing the old directory before publishing fresh input and null completion metadata, capture_read only appending inputs, record rejecting invalid output and stale inputs before writing output then completion time, load_saved ignoring uncommitted output and reporting malformed records, and validate checking every current anchor for absent output, output_error, requested edits and input_errors. Locking and atomic per-file writes prevent readers observing mixed attempts. Semantic completeness and reviewer assignment remain the stated human workflow responsibility, not inferred from a nonblank string. Captured check.rs, main.rs and workspace.rs confirm CLI and Cargo share the same check/ensure_valid failure path; these are generic gate plumbing rather than missing record-specific implementation. Captured tests/review.rs supplies Fixture helpers: approve starts and records, run executes the actual binary, and isolated fixtures begin with a valid model and associations.

Associated tests account for: start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required checks initial failure, approval, restart clearing output and completion, failure after a captured read, preserved inputs and success only after record; interrupted_start_publication_states_cannot_reuse_an_old_approval checks missing directory, empty directory, input-only and successful restart states through both library and CLI; incomplete_output_publication_never_satisfies_the_gate checks output without completion, completion missing output and malformed uncommitted output; restarting_one_anchor_leaves_other_anchor_record_unchanged checks aggregate failure despite another approved anchor and byte preservation of its record. These substantively cover lifecycle and independent anchors. The newly associated invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects blank reviewer/report/edit and stale recording, preserves captured inputs on failure, and accepts-but-fails a requested-edits report. The newly associated diagnostics_identify_missing_unfinished_stale_and_requested_edit_reviews asserts CLI failure after changing implementation following approval and after recording edits, including anchor and skill guidance. Together all six tests cover the complete claim; prior requested association edits are resolved. Re-read current associated bodies and checked the fresh implementation snapshot against the previous inspected snapshot: review.rs behavior is unchanged. Freshly captured complete test helper source, check.rs, main.rs and workspace.rs, so this judgment persists its dependencies rather than relying solely on comparison. No implementation or test edits remain requested.

Latest refresh assessment: compared all fresh initial fragments and full association metadata to the independently inspected prior inputs. The complete claim, sole implementation file and all six associated test bodies are unchanged. Recaptured all relied-on helper/gate files through review read. The sole additional-read delta is three test annotations in tests/review.rs: source_representation on complete_claim_blocks_are_selected_but_unrelated_movement_is_not_stale and whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits, and staleness on unsupported_versions_and_mismatched_identity_cannot_pass. These do not change fixture behavior, implementation or this anchor's complete association set; the claim-to-code and test adequacy reasoning above still holds. check.rs, main.rs and workspace.rs remain identical to previously inspected source. No requested edits.

Commands personally executed for this latest refresh: cargo meta review start meta.reviews.record_required --instructions /tmp/sage-refresh-11.txt, cargo meta review read for tests/review.rs, src/check.rs, src/main.rs and tests/workspace.rs, and input/source delta inspection; then cargo meta review record. No source edits or behavioral tests in this refresh. The coordinator reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests and workspace build passing; those are reported execution, not tests run by this reviewer. The earlier quality-check result and earlier fmt execution are historical and are not asserted as newly executed here.
